meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把对话压缩成交接文档,让下一个智能体顺利接手。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在多个智能体之间接力完成任务。
copy.tagline_en: Compress the conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to hand off context between agents in a multi-step task.

howto.what: 把当前对话压缩成一份交接文档,保存到操作系统的临时目录(不是当前工作区),让新的 agent 能接着往下做。文档里含一节「建议调用的技能」,并会隐去 API 密钥、密码、个人信息等敏感内容。
howto.when: 当你想把当前这轮对话交给另一个 agent 接手时使用。该技能需手动调用,模型不会自动触发。

say.text: 把当前对话整理成交接文档,下一个会话要接着做数据库迁移
say.note: 会按你给的用途定制文档内容

say.text: 生成交接文档,存到系统临时目录
say.note: 文档不会放进当前工作区

say.text: 交接文档里列一下建议调用的技能
say.note: 文档会加上 suggested skills 一节

howto.what_en: Compacts the current conversation into a handoff document saved to the OS temp directory, not the current workspace, so a fresh agent can continue the work. It includes a suggested-skills section and redacts sensitive data such as API keys or passwords.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want another agent to pick up the current work. It must be invoked manually; the model cannot trigger it by itself.

say_en.text: Turn this conversation into a handoff doc; next session continues the DB migration.
say_en.note: The doc is tailored to the purpose you give.

say_en.text: Write the handoff doc to the system temp directory.
say_en.note: It is not saved in the current workspace.

say_en.text: List the skills the next agent should invoke in the handoff doc.
